zh-CN.name: 模块制作
zh-CN.description: 将可复用的技能、工具、数据或知识整理为可安装的 TransportX 模块包。
features: 编写模块清单，声明入口、依赖与资源
组合 Skill、工具扩展、数据、知识和模板
检查路径、资料来源和包结构，并准备安装包

en-US.name: Module Authoring
en-US.description: Packages reusable skills, tools, data and knowledge as installable TransportX modules.
features: Writes manifests declaring entry points, dependencies and resources
Combines skills, tool extensions, data, knowledge and templates
Checks paths, sources and package layout before installation
